bodies.summary: Drawer that slides inside the housing channel. Has side guide ribs, front face for pulling, and internal storage volume.

design_summary: A stationary housing (BOD-0012) with a rectangular internal channel along X, and a drawer (BOD-0013) that slides in this channel. The drawer has two side guide ribs that run in slots in the housing, a front pull face (functional region FRG-0013), and a stop shoulder at the rear. The housing provides an aperture at X=-3 for access to the drawer's front face. Friction hold is achieved by a slight interference or textured contact on the guides, and open/closed positions are limited by stop faces at the front and rear of the housing.
